notes: New 'Named locations' tab in Conditional Access — see every IP range and country list, each marked Enforced or Not enforced (no enabled policy references it). Gives visibility even when there are no issues.
'Not enforced' locations also raise a Policy hygiene finding (a country block that isn't actually in effect = medium), computed from the same rule so the tab and the finding always agree.
Run a backup on demand, restore any snapshot, and edit the daily/weekly schedule from Conditional Access → Backup & Restore.
